senses.en: found naturally only in one particular place
regularly found among people in a particular area

ex.en: This flower is endemic to the island.
ex.zh: 这种花是这座岛特有的。

ex.en: Because many species on the islands are endemic, the arrival of rats and goats caused extinctions that could not be reversed elsewhere.
ex.zh: 由于岛上许多物种为当地特有，老鼠和山羊的到来导致了无法在别处挽回的灭绝。

tip: endemic to + 地点；别和 epidemic（流行病）混淆。

senses.en: Having more than one spouse at the same time.

ex.en: Polygamy is illegal in many countries.
ex.zh: 多偶制在许多国家是违法的。

senses.en: Having only one partner at a time.

ex.en: Monogamy is rare among mammals.
ex.zh: 一夫一妻制在哺乳动物中很少见。

senses.en: A man having more than one wife.

ex.en: Polygyny was practiced by some kings.
ex.zh: 一些国王实行一夫多妻。

senses.en: A woman having more than one husband.

ex.en: Polyandry occurs in parts of the Himalayas.
ex.zh: 喜马拉雅部分地区存在一妻多夫制。

senses.en: Money or goods a bride's family gives at marriage.

ex.en: Her dowry included land and cattle.
ex.zh: 她的嫁妆包括土地和牛。

senses.en: Form an opinion using limited evidence
An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain

ex.en: Seeing wet umbrellas, I surmised that it was raining.
ex.zh: 看到湿漉漉的雨伞，我猜外面正在下雨。

ex.en: Researchers surmise that flexible schedules improve employee wellbeing, although stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.
ex.zh: 研究人员推测弹性工作时间能改善员工身心状况，但仍需更有力的证据加以确认。

tip: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

senses.en: Marrying outside one's own group.

ex.en: Exogamy builds alliances between clans.
ex.zh: 族外婚在氏族之间建立联盟。

senses.en: Marrying within one's own group.

ex.en: Caste rules required endogamy.
ex.zh: 种姓规则要求族内通婚。

senses.en: The belief that natural objects have spirits.

ex.en: Animism sees spirits in rivers and trees.
ex.zh: 万物有灵论认为河流和树木都有灵魂。

senses.en: A person who believes natural objects have spirits.

ex.en: Animist beliefs shaped local festivals.
ex.zh: 万物有灵的信仰塑造了当地节日。

senses.en: A person believed to communicate with spirits and heal the sick.

ex.en: The shaman led the healing ceremony.
ex.zh: 萨满主持了治疗仪式。

senses.en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions

ex.en: My rental agreement is terminable with one month's notice.
ex.zh: 我的租约可以提前一个月通知后终止。

ex.en: Employment contracts should be terminable by either party, provided that reasonable notice is given.
ex.zh: 只要给予合理的提前通知，雇佣合同应允许任何一方终止。

col: terminable on notice｜通知后可终止的
terminable by either party｜任何一方均可终止的
tip: 正式法律用语，常形容合同；不等于terminal。

senses.en: Religious practice centered on shamans.

ex.en: Shamanism is found across Siberia.
ex.zh: 萨满教遍布西伯利亚。

senses.en: A formal religious or traditional ceremony.

ex.en: The rite marked a boy's passage to manhood.
ex.zh: 这个仪式标志着男孩成年。

senses.en: A ceremony for joining a group; the start of something.

ex.en: Initiation rites were held at puberty.
ex.zh: 成年礼在青春期举行。

senses.en: Belief in a spiritual link between a group and an animal or plant.

ex.en: Totemism links clans to animals.
ex.zh: 图腾崇拜把氏族与动物联系起来。

senses.en: Relating to myths; very famous or exaggerated.

ex.en: The founder became a mythic figure.
ex.zh: 这位创始人成了传奇人物。

senses.en: say what will happen, especially through claimed spiritual knowledge

ex.en: The old storyteller prophesied that the kingdom would prosper.
ex.zh: 那位年老的说书人预言这个王国会繁荣兴盛。

ex.en: Some early commentators prophesied that television would replace books, but reading has remained an important cultural activity.
ex.zh: 一些早期评论者曾预言电视会取代书籍，但阅读始终是一项重要的文化活动。

senses.en: Traditional stories and beliefs of a community.

ex.en: Dragons appear in Chinese folklore.
ex.zh: 龙出现在中国民间传说中。

senses.en: A West African storyteller who keeps oral history.

ex.en: The griot sang the history of the kings.
ex.zh: 格里奥吟唱了历代国王的历史。

senses.en: A poet who sings stories; a poet.

ex.en: The bard sang of ancient battles.
ex.zh: 吟游诗人歌唱古代的战争。

senses.en: A Pacific Northwest feast where hosts give away goods to show status.

ex.en: Chiefs gained prestige by hosting a potlatch.
ex.zh: 首领通过举办夸富宴赢得威望。

senses.en: Exchanging things for mutual benefit.

ex.en: Gift-giving is based on reciprocity.
ex.zh: 送礼基于互惠原则。

senses.en: An indirect suggestion or indication of something.

ex.en: His sudden silence gave us an intimation of trouble.
ex.zh: 他突然沉默，让我们隐约感到出了问题。

ex.en: The minister's remarks offered the first intimation that funding for public transport might increase.
ex.zh: 部长的讲话首次暗示，公共交通资金可能会增加。

col: an intimation of trouble｜麻烦的征兆
tip: 别与intimacy（亲密）混淆；常接of或that从句。

senses.en: Collecting and sharing out goods again.

ex.en: The chief controlled the redistribution of food.
ex.zh: 首领掌管食物的再分配。

senses.en: Believing that all people are equal.

ex.en: Hunter-gatherer bands were largely egalitarian.
ex.zh: 狩猎采集群体大多是平等的。

senses.en: Division into layers or classes.

ex.en: Social stratification grew with farming.
ex.zh: 社会分层随着农业而加剧。

senses.en: The leader of a tribe or clan.

ex.en: The chieftain led his warriors into battle.
ex.zh: 首领率领战士们出征。

senses.en: The leader of a village or community.

ex.en: The headman welcomed the visitors.
ex.zh: 村长欢迎了来访者。

senses.en: Thick and sticky, especially when cooked

ex.en: The glutinous rice stuck firmly to my wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 糯米牢牢地粘在了我的木勺上。

ex.en: Glutinous rice is used in many traditional dishes, reflecting the importance of texture in regional cuisines.
ex.zh: 许多传统菜肴使用糯米，体现了口感在地方饮食中的重要性。

tip: glutinous指黏性；糯米本身不含麸质gluten。

senses.en: A very small village.

ex.en: The hamlet has only twelve houses.
ex.zh: 这个小村庄只有十二户人家。

senses.en: A place with temporary shelters or tents.

ex.en: Traces of a hunting encampment were found.
ex.zh: 发现了一处狩猎营地的遗迹。

senses.en: A long communal house shared by several families.

ex.en: Iroquois families lived in longhouses.
ex.zh: 易洛魁家庭住在长屋里。

senses.en: A dome-shaped hut of poles covered with bark or hides.

ex.en: The wigwam was covered with birch bark.
ex.zh: 棚屋上覆盖着桦树皮。

senses.en: A cone-shaped tent of animal skins used by Plains peoples.

ex.en: The tepee could be packed up quickly.
ex.zh: 圆锥形帐篷可以很快收起。

senses.en: An excessive display of wealth or importance to impress others.

ex.en: Their wedding was warm and cheerful, without any ostentation.
ex.zh: 他们的婚礼温馨愉快，没有丝毫铺张炫耀。

ex.en: The ostentation associated with luxury consumption can intensify social pressure to display wealth rather than save responsibly.
ex.zh: 奢侈消费中的炫富行为可能加剧社会压力，促使人们展示财富而非理性储蓄。

col: an air of ostentation｜炫耀的气派
tip: 不可数名词，通常含贬义，强调故意展示以引人注目。

senses.en: A dome-shaped house built of snow blocks.

ex.en: Hunters built an igloo for the night.
ex.zh: 猎人们搭了一座冰屋过夜。

senses.en: A round felt tent used by nomads in Central Asia.

ex.en: The family lives in a yurt in summer.
ex.zh: 这家人夏天住在蒙古包里。

senses.en: Sun-dried brick made of clay and straw.

ex.en: Adobe houses stay cool in the desert.
ex.zh: 土坯房在沙漠中保持凉爽。

senses.en: Dried straw or reeds used as roofing.

ex.en: The cottage has a roof of thatch.
ex.zh: 这座小屋有茅草屋顶。

senses.en: Covered with a roof of straw or reeds.

ex.en: They lived in a thatched hut.
ex.zh: 他们住在一间茅草屋里。

senses.en: The narrow lower part of the uterus opening into the vagina.

ex.en: The nurse explained where the cervix is on the model.
ex.zh: 护士在模型上讲解了子宫颈的位置。

ex.en: Regular screening can detect abnormal cells in the cervix before they develop into a serious health problem.
ex.zh: 定期筛查可以在子宫颈异常细胞发展成严重健康问题之前发现它们。

col: the cervix of the uterus｜子宫颈
cells of the cervix｜子宫颈细胞
cancer of the cervix｜子宫颈癌
tip: 通常指子宫颈；cervical 也可表示颈部的。

senses.en: The floor of a fireplace; home.

ex.en: Ash from the hearth was carbon dated.
ex.zh: 炉膛里的灰烬做了碳测年。

senses.en: Cutting hillsides into flat steps for farming.

ex.en: Terracing prevents soil erosion on slopes.
ex.zh: 修梯田可以防止坡地水土流失。

senses.en: A raised road across water or wet ground.

ex.en: A causeway linked the island to the shore.
ex.zh: 一条堤道把小岛和海岸连接起来。

senses.en: A bank or mound of earth built as a defense or monument.

ex.en: The hill is ringed by ancient earthworks.
ex.zh: 山周围环绕着古代土垒。

senses.en: A defensive wall of earth or stone.

ex.en: Soldiers stood guard on the rampart.
ex.zh: 士兵们站在城墙上守卫。

senses.en: A fence of wooden stakes for defense.

ex.en: A palisade surrounded the village.
ex.zh: 木栅栏环绕着村庄。

senses.en: Someone who murders an important person, often for political reasons.

ex.en: The film's assassinator hid behind a heavy curtain.
ex.zh: 电影中的暗杀者藏在厚重的窗帘后面。

ex.en: The historical account examines the assassinator's motives and the political instability that followed the killing.
ex.zh: 这份历史记述探讨了暗杀者的动机，以及暗杀事件随后引发的政治动荡。

col: the assassinator's motives｜暗杀者的动机
tip: 此词罕见；通常用assassin表示暗杀者。

senses.en: A defensive barrier of upright posts.

ex.en: Settlers built a stockade for protection.
ex.zh: 移民建了一道栅栏来自保。

senses.en: A wall or building constructed for defense.

ex.en: Stone fortifications protected the city.
ex.zh: 石砌防御工事保护着城市。

senses.en: A fortress protecting a city.

ex.en: The citadel stands on the highest hill.
ex.zh: 城堡矗立在最高的山上。

senses.en: The fortified high area of an ancient Greek city.

ex.en: The Parthenon stands on the Acropolis.
ex.zh: 帕特农神庙矗立在雅典卫城上。

senses.en: A stepped pyramid temple of ancient Mesopotamia.

ex.en: The ziggurat rose above the city of Ur.
ex.zh: 塔庙高耸于乌尔城之上。

senses.en: A unit of dry volume used especially for grain.

ex.en: The farmer measured out a bushel of wheat.
ex.zh: 农民量出了一蒲式耳小麦。

ex.en: Reporting grain prices per bushel allows farmers to compare market conditions before deciding when to sell their crops.
ex.zh: 按每蒲式耳报告谷物价格，便于农民比较市场行情，再决定何时出售作物。

col: a bushel of wheat｜一蒲式耳小麦
tip: 是干量单位；英美容量不同，不能直接等同固定重量。

senses.en: A holy place dedicated to a god or saint.

ex.en: Pilgrims visited the shrine.
ex.zh: 朝圣者参拜了圣地。

senses.en: A table used in religious ceremonies.

ex.en: Offerings were placed on the altar.
ex.zh: 供品被放在祭坛上。

senses.en: A drink poured out as an offering to a god.

ex.en: Wine was poured as a libation.
ex.zh: 酒被洒在地上作为奠酒。

senses.en: A priest or place believed to give messages from the gods.

ex.en: The oracle at Delphi gave cryptic answers.
ex.zh: 德尔斐神谕给出了晦涩的回答。

senses.en: Trying to foretell the future by supernatural means.

ex.en: Oracle bones were used for divination.
ex.zh: 甲骨被用于占卜。

senses.en: to mention a law, idea or person to support an argument
to make people have a particular feeling or memory

ex.en: He invoked his right to remain silent.
ex.zh: 他援引了保持沉默的权利。

ex.en: To explain the sudden disappearance of the species, some scientists invoked a dramatic climate shift, while others pointed to overhunting.
ex.zh: 为了解释该物种的突然消失，一些科学家援引剧烈气候变化，另一些则归因于过度捕猎。

tip: 区分 invoke（援引）与 evoke（唤起情感）。

senses.en: A sign of what will happen; reading omens.

ex.en: Romans practiced augury by watching birds.
ex.zh: 罗马人通过观察鸟类进行占卜。

senses.en: A person who claims to predict the future.

ex.en: A soothsayer warned Caesar of danger.
ex.zh: 一位预言者警告恺撒有危险。

senses.en: A woman who performs religious duties.

ex.en: The priestess tended the sacred fire.
ex.zh: 女祭司照看圣火。

senses.en: A system of worship; a small extreme religious group.

ex.en: The cult of Isis spread across the Roman Empire.
ex.zh: 伊西斯崇拜传遍了罗马帝国。

senses.en: All the gods of a religion; a group of famous people.

ex.en: Zeus ruled the Greek pantheon.
ex.zh: 宙斯统领希腊众神。

senses.en: necessary for a particular purpose

ex.en: They packed everything needful for the long winter journey.
ex.zh: 他们装好了漫长冬日旅途所需的一切物品。

ex.en: Reliable access to clean water is needful for maintaining public health in isolated rural communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的清洁用水供应是偏远农村社区维持公共卫生的必要条件。

col: do the needful｜采取必要行动
tip: 较古旧或正式；雅思写作通常用 necessary。

senses.en: Belief in many gods.

ex.en: Ancient Egyptian religion was a form of polytheism.
ex.zh: 古埃及宗教是一种多神信仰。

senses.en: Belief in one god.

ex.en: Monotheism spread across the Middle East.
ex.zh: 一神论在中东传播开来。

senses.en: Believing in many gods.

ex.en: The Romans were polytheistic.
ex.zh: 罗马人信奉多神。

senses.en: Believing in one god.

ex.en: Judaism is a monotheistic religion.
ex.zh: 犹太教是一神教。

senses.en: Great respect or worship.

ex.en: Ancestor veneration is common in East Asia.
ex.zh: 祖先崇拜在东亚很普遍。

senses.en: lying flat with your face towards the ground

senses.zh: 精疲力竭的；悲痛难支的
senses.en: overwhelmed by exhaustion, illness, or strong emotion
to make someone lie face down or become extremely weak

ex.en: After crawling under the fence, he lay prostrate on the grass.
ex.zh: 从围栏下爬过去后，他俯卧在草地上。

ex.en: Extreme heat can leave outdoor workers prostrate with exhaustion, highlighting the importance of regular breaks.
ex.zh: 酷热会使户外工作者疲惫不堪，凸显了定时休息的重要性。

col: prostrate with exhaustion｜疲惫得无法动弹
tip: 勿与prostate（前列腺）混淆；注意多一个r。

senses.en: The images and symbols linked to a subject, or their study.

ex.en: The iconography of the temple shows serpents.
ex.zh: 神庙的图像以蛇为主题。

senses.en: The use of symbols to represent ideas.

ex.en: The dove's symbolism is peace.
ex.zh: 鸽子象征和平。

senses.en: Adopting traits of another culture through contact.

ex.en: Acculturation changed their diet and dress.
ex.zh: 文化适应改变了他们的饮食和服饰。

senses.en: Learning one's own culture while growing up.

ex.en: Children learn norms through enculturation.
ex.zh: 儿童通过文化习得学会社会规范。

senses.en: Judging other cultures by the standards of your own.

ex.en: Early explorers often showed ethnocentrism.
ex.zh: 早期探险家常表现出民族中心主义。

senses.en: Showing the distinctive qualities of a person or thing.

ex.en: The old guide describes the village's characteristical stone cottages.
ex.zh: 那本旧指南描述了这个村庄独具特色的石屋。

ex.en: The historical account highlights the characteristical features of rural architecture, including local stone and steep roofs.
ex.zh: 这份历史记述突出介绍了乡村建筑的典型特征，包括当地石材和陡峭屋顶。

tip: 罕见旧式形式；现代写作应优先用characteristic。
note: 罕见旧式形容词，现代英语通常用 characteristic。

senses.en: Judging other cultures by your own standards.

ex.en: The report was criticized as ethnocentric.
ex.zh: 这份报告被批评带有民族中心主义。

senses.en: A person who farms small plots with simple tools.

ex.en: Horticulturalists used digging sticks.
ex.zh: 园耕者使用挖掘棒。

senses.en: A farmer, or an expert in agriculture.

ex.en: Agriculturalists settled the river valley.
ex.zh: 农耕者在河谷定居下来。

senses.en: The time before written records.

ex.en: Most of human history is prehistory.
ex.zh: 人类历史的大部分是史前时期。

senses.en: Relating to the period just before written history.

ex.en: Protohistoric sites are known from later accounts.
ex.zh: 原史时期的遗址见于后世的记载。

senses.en: extreme poverty, with too little money for basic needs

ex.en: After years of penury, she could finally afford heating.
ex.zh: 经历多年赤贫之后，她终于付得起取暖费了。

ex.en: Without adequate social protection, prolonged unemployment can push vulnerable households into penury and damage their health.
ex.zh: 如果没有充分的社会保障，长期失业可能使弱势家庭陷入赤贫，并损害他们的健康。

col: live in penury｜生活在赤贫中
die in penury｜在贫困中去世
reduce someone to penury｜使某人陷入赤贫
tip: 正式或文学用词，程度重于poverty，通常不可数。

senses.en: The ancient past, especially before the Middle Ages; great age.

ex.en: The temple dates from antiquity.
ex.zh: 这座神庙可追溯到古代。

senses.en: Objects from ancient times.

ex.en: The museum's antiquities include Greek vases.
ex.zh: 博物馆的古物包括希腊花瓶。

senses.en: A person who studies or collects old things.

ex.en: An antiquarian first described the ruins.
ex.zh: 一位古物研究者最先描述了这些遗迹。

senses.en: The ancient region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

ex.en: Writing began in Mesopotamia.
ex.zh: 文字起源于美索不达米亚。

senses.en: Relating to ancient Mesopotamia.

ex.en: Mesopotamian farmers dug irrigation canals.
ex.zh: 美索不达米亚的农民挖了灌溉渠。

senses.en: To grow or develop rapidly.

ex.en: Her interest in gardening burgeoned after she moved here.
ex.zh: 搬到这里后，她对园艺的兴趣迅速增长。

ex.en: Demand for online courses has burgeoned as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop professional skills.
ex.zh: 随着越来越多成年人寻求灵活提升职业技能的机会，在线课程的需求迅速增长。

col: a burgeoning industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
a burgeoning population｜迅速增长的人口
tip: 现代常作不及物动词；burgeoning常用于名词前。

senses.en: Relating to Sumer, the earliest civilization in Mesopotamia.

ex.en: Sumerian scribes wrote on clay.
ex.zh: 苏美尔书吏在泥板上书写。

senses.en: Relating to the ancient city or empire of Babylon.

ex.en: Babylonian astronomers tracked the planets.
ex.zh: 巴比伦天文学家追踪行星的运行。

senses.en: Relating to the ancient empire of Assyria.

ex.en: Assyrian kings built great palaces.
ex.zh: 亚述国王建造了宏伟的宫殿。

senses.en: A ruler of ancient Egypt.

ex.en: The pharaoh was seen as a god.
ex.zh: 法老被视为神。

senses.en: Relating to the pharaohs; very large and grand.

ex.en: Pharaonic tombs were filled with treasure.
ex.zh: 法老的陵墓里满是财宝。

senses.en: A machine that cuts meat into very small pieces.

ex.en: We used a mincer to prepare meat for dumplings.
ex.zh: 我们用绞肉机处理肉，准备包饺子。

ex.en: Small food businesses can improve efficiency by using an electric mincer rather than chopping meat by hand.
ex.zh: 小型食品企业可以使用电动绞肉机代替手工剁肉，以提高效率。

tip: 英式英语常用mincer，美式常用meat grinder。

senses.en: Relating to a series of rulers from one family.

ex.en: Dynastic Egypt lasted 3,000 years.
ex.zh: 王朝时期的埃及延续了三千年。

senses.en: Relating to the Bronze Age civilization of Crete.

ex.en: Minoan palaces had running water.
ex.zh: 米诺斯宫殿有自来水。
